newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $15.53 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $15.53 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves rose $101 million, or 0.7 percent, in the week to February 3 to $15.529 billion, according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were up from $15.428 billion on January 27, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Foreign reserves are now up $5.726 billion from reserve levels of $9.702 billion on April 19 -- the last working day before exchange controls were lifted on April 22 last year.
The sustained rise has complicated monetary policy, government officials have said, increasing liquidity.
Reserves closed last year at $15.229 billion and are expected to top $20 billion by the end of 1997, officials have said.
